SOURCE: https://cursor.com/changelog
SCANNED: 2026-08-30
NEWEST: 2026-08-27  (was 2026-08-19 on the previous scan)

NEW SINCE LAST SCAN - 2026-08-27:
- "Start from scratch": Cloud Agents can now launch with NO GitHub or third-party SCM connection. Select
  "Start from scratch" in the repo picker and prompt the agent; Cursor automatically creates an Origin repo in the
  background. When the work is good, click "Create repo" to save it as a named Origin repository with configurable
  visibility (private or internal). The fully scaffolded repo appears in the Codebase tab.
- In-browser live preview: Cursor "port-forwards your cloud agent's live environment straight to your browser",
  giving real-time preview and design-mode access during the session.
- Publish with Vercel: connect a Vercel account and deploy the finished work to get a LIVE URL. "A Vercel account
  is required to use the publish feature."

PREVIOUSLY REPORTED / HELD:
- 2026-08-19 Subscriptions (agents watch PRs and Slack threads), Custom Modes, subagent isolation on independent
  VMs, /goal, non-blocking steering. [reported 08-21]
- 2026-08-17 Cursor Origin git forge, bidirectional GitHub sync, Vercel/Depot/Buildkite integrations. [reported 08-21]
- 2026-08-03 Google Workspace plugins - Gmail (search/read messages, draft and send, manage labels and threads),
  Google Drive (search files, access content, create and organize documents), Google Calendar (access schedules,
  create/update events, identify availability). Changelog does not document the authorization mechanism or scopes.
  [surfaced 2026-08-07 scan]
